defects.description: Description: SIT on floor + LOWER TORSO BACK GRADUALLY ONTO BOTH ELBOWS. Torso goes BACKWARD (supine-leaning, globalTilt NEGATIVE). Current globalTilt=+75 (mostly PRONE = face-DOWN). Body is leaning FORWARD not BACKWARD — opposite of description. cron-round-1 missed this pose. Should be globalTilt=-45 (mid-recline back between sitting and lying).

Description: lower torso back onto BOTH ELBOWS (elbows supporting torso from behind). Current no shoulderFwd set, both elbows at y=0.093/0.086 (just above hip level, in front of body z=0.285/0.261). Elbows are not on floor behind body for support. Need shoulderFwdL/R POSITIVE (BEHIND in body frame per corrected convention) to swing arms backward/down to floor for elbow prop.

failing_tests: description says lower torso back but globalTilt=+75 (forward/prone not back/supine)
description says onto both elbows but no shoulderFwd set, elbows in front not behind
regression_risk: medium — 6-field change including globalTilt sign flip (CRITICAL fix). Sign flip from +75 (prone) to -45 (supine-leaning) is major reorientation. Re-render verify REQUIRED. May need to verify legs remain forward (leftHip=80, rightHip=80 preserved) after globalTilt flip — legs should extend forward along floor when torso reclines back.
rationale: Description: Sit on the floor and lower the torso back gradually onto both elbows, legs bent or extended forward. A relaxed mid-point between sitting up and lying flat. Current pose has globalTilt=+75 (PRONE-leaning, body forward) — opposite of description lower torso BACK. This is a SIGN ERROR (cron-round-1 missed this pose). Per corrected convention +90=PRONE, -90=SUPINE. Fix: (1) globalTilt +75→-45 (CRITICAL sign flip — body now supine-leaning back, mid-point between sitting upright 0° and lying flat -90° ✓). (2) Both elbows supporting behind body: shoulderFwdL 0→+60 + shoulderFwdR 0→+60 (both arms swing BEHIND body per corrected convention + = behind; in supine-leaning pose body-behind maps to DOWN-BACK in world frame, elbows go to floor behind body for support ✓). (3) rightShoulder 12→0 (RIGHT arm at neutral, both arms symmetric for elbow support). (4) leftElbow 81→60, rightElbow 81→60 (less bend, forearms more extended for support base). Legs preserved: leftHip=80, rightHip=80 (deep flexion, legs forward), leftKnee=5, rightKnee=5 (knees straight, legs extended forward ✓ matches description legs bent or extended forward). After globalTilt flip, legs rotate with body — legs should extend forward along floor. Re-render verify REQUIRED. Rig-limited: no hip-origin-y control, elbow cannot truly prop on floor from elevated torso — approximation.
